description: Import bookmarks from an HTML file into Microsoft Edge. A 'Personalize your feed' dialog may appear on launch - dismiss it by clicking the X button if present. The bookmarks file has been copied to /home/ga/bookmarks_to_import.html and contains 40 bookmarks organized in folders like News & Media, Technology, Reference, etc. Use Edge's import feature to import bookmarks from this HTML file. After importing, the bookmarks should appear in the Edge Favorites.
